analysis:
Reviewed the autopilot residency changes. ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement.swift (new) adds in-memory adoption and holds. Adoption lets a succeeded command's inventory target keep being advertised after the lease ends. withdrawInactiveAutopilotModels now skips valid adoptions (Inventory head line 15). Adoption validity (Placement lines 18-33) requires several conditions: not shutting down; autopilotConsented, which includes !privateOnly; settings.allows(id); a resident slot; not retiring; no failedSelfTestHashes entry; and a nonempty inventory weightHash. reconcileAutopilotPlacements runs on every snapshot publication (Autopilot head line 21) and withdraws adoptions whose basis has ended. Holds expire monotonically and also need the model to be advertised. Neither persists across restart. I found no widening of serving beyond operator-selected models, and no bypass of the self-test, private-only or retirement gates. This is relevant to T-027 and T-012 (weight integrity), which still depend on the existing hash and self-test gates.

Busy reasons (AutopilotBusy.swift) mirror the previous busy boolean (base lines 123-129). Detail and extended snapshot fields are sent to the trusted coordinator only with saved consent (head lines 57-63, 272). They are coarse state enums, not A-001 data.

Command-controlled holdSeconds is used at Placement line 64 in `Int64(seconds) * 1_000` with a trapping multiply, and in `.seconds(seconds)`. An extreme value could trap. The coordinator is trusted, and validation may live in ModelAutopilotPolicy, which was not supplied, so I did not report this as a finding.

Open questions for integration:
- ProviderLoop+TransitionWatchdog.swift content was not in my units. The orientation excerpt shows it cancels the accepted autopilot task on stall. Integration should confirm that cancelling mid-mutation, after autopilotMutationStarted, cannot leave a target advertised without the reserve or pendingAdvertise cleanup (Inventory lines 69-85 catch path).
- Unseen callers of autopilotServesModel and autopilotHoldsModel, and the LRU/idle eviction integration, should be checked so that held weights cannot starve admission. autopilotHeldWeightBytes saturates on overflow.
